channel.title: Researches on Marginalia
channel.description: Recent content in Researches on Marginalia

item.title: Judges in the Judicial Process of the United States
item.description: A structured guide to U.S. judges and judicial offices across federal and state systems, including tenure, appointment, elections, powers, and pay.

item.title: Dead Symbols and their Worship
item.description: An intentionally severe, aphoristic essay arguing that parts of mathematical culture confuse abstraction, difficulty, and proximity to unsolved problems with intellectual strength, while undervaluing synthesis, closure, pedagogy, and completed mastery.

item.title: Brickmaking: History, Materials, Processes, and Production Planning
item.description: Covers brickmaking from raw-material preparation through forming, drying, firing, testing, environmental control, production-scale planning, and current kiln-decarbonization work, while distinguishing stable process knowledge from time-sensitive standards and project economics.

item.title: Critical Review of Major Official Financial-Crisis Inquiry Reports
item.description: Compares the FCIC and major U.K. inquiry reports with primary evidence on investment-bank supervision, housing policy, AIG and Bear Stearns rescue design, and shadow banking, distinguishing legitimate framing critique from unsupported claims of institutional intent.
